purpose: Optional prompt lookup candidates only; semantic editor chooses or rejects a sense against the actual line, grammar, adjacent poetry and audio transcript. No search/index engine implied.
sense_id_policy: IDs are local curation labels, not sense numbers assigned by Platts. Exact print page, homograph and definition anchors identify the actual dictionary evidence.
language_boundary: All five entries are directly attested classical Hindi/Hindustani entries in Platts. Sanskrit etymologies mentioned there are not independent Sanskrit lexical validation. Do not apply mechanically to Punjabi, Marathi, Sanskrit or any other language; acquire language-specific evidence first.
transliteration_boundary: Roman search aliases reproduce convenient Platts-style headwords. They are retrieval keys, not authorization to rewrite performed IAST or source spelling.
